calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original game character portrait and identity reference for Adventure World 2, spirit aw2-lua, Lửa Nhỏ, breakfast-delivery Striker affiliated with bánh mì. Create one warm, nimble young adult courier with a compact light build, short tousled chestnut hair, bright attentive brown eyes, short burnt-orange scarf, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, teal cropped delivery jacket, dark tapered trousers, fingerless padded gloves with a subtle steam-stroke motif, and a practical small canvas breakfast delivery satchel across the torso. Human ears, original face, no weapon, no shield. Chest-up three-quarter portrait, both shoulders and the delivery satchel strap visible, energetic kind smile. Original polished HD anime game illustration, precise clean linework, soft cel shading, warm orange and restrained teal palette. Center subject within generous transparent margins on a genuinely transparent background. No text, no labels, no frame, no logo, no food mascot, no external franchise or artist reference. This portrait is also the identity reference for separate full-body battle and chibi world assets.
